before.title: Ateca 2.0 TSI Water Pump / Thermostat Failure
before.description: The EA888 Gen 3 2.0 TSI water pump is a plastic-housing assembly integrating the thermostat. The plastic housing cracks at the seam typically 70,000-130,000 km, causing coolant loss, sweet smell, and overheating. Same part used across SEAT Ateca/Tarraco, VW Tiguan, Audi Q3, Skoda Kodiaq.
before.solution: Complete water pump + thermostat module replacement €400-€700 incl. labor and coolant. Use VW G13 coolant (pink, do not mix with G12++ green-pink) and bleed properly — air locks are common.
